summary: Part 2 of 3 (02:20-04:45) of the Revibe training "12.0 South Africa Bulk Shipments (Seller & KAMs)". The trainer walks through packing a Quiqup bulk box in the Revibe box panel (scan every device, remove any device not in the box, seal with red tape and film it), then the hand-over (press "Mark ready for collection" only when the Quiqup rider is there, usually around 3 PM; print the Quiqup label and stick it on the box), then tracking the box and fixing exceptions (Missing and Can't scan), and finally a daily checklist. 43 frames were opened: the 40 frames cited in the pack plus t00285, t00288 and t00290, which no claim cited. The hand-over table shows four device rows while the packing list had six devices, which is logged as unclear.

screens.shows: Pink 'Missing' header; rows ZA-85669-1 and ZA-85723-1 with checks, ZA-85654-1 in a pink row; tan box graphic; 'ZA-85654-1 → Order created' and 'Put it in your next box'.

screens.name: Missing panel with empty slot
screens.shows: The box graphic beside the Missing panel shows a dashed red outline over an empty slot where the device should be.

screens.name: Can't scan panel
screens.shows: Magenta 'Can't scan' header; scanner gun, crossed-out barcode RV-15-441625; 'Back to you the next day'; 'Reprint its barcode' with a printer icon.

screens.name: Scan status table
screens.shows: Columns Order Help, Device Name, Scan status; rows ZA-85669-1, ZA-85654-1, ZA-85719-1, ZA-85753-1 with Scan status 'Scanned' or 'Pickup failed' (red cross on ZA-85719-1); the Scan status column is outlined in pink.

screens.name: Daily checklist
screens.shows: Purple slide 'Daily checklist', subtitle 'Print it and keep it next to your packing table', six checkboxes: Ready for pickup on every South Africa order; A barcode on every device: flat, whole, readable; Box matches the Open box list, every barcode scanned; Anything not in the box removed in the panel; Box sealed with red tape, sealing filmed; Rider here: Mark ready for collection, label on top. Boxes are ticked progressively from t00266 to t00281.

screens.name: Closing slide
screens.shows: REVIBE logo on a purple gradient with the pill 'Questions? Message your Revibe account manager.' and 'Thank you!'.

terms.meaning: The courier that collects the box. Shown on screen as the carrier and in 'QUIQUP BOX'. The narration says QuickUp.
The box used to pack all of the day's devices. Quiqup sends it together with the red tape.
The box being packed in the Revibe box panel. The panel lists its devices; the tracker also has an 'Open box' tab.
Badge on the box panel while devices can still be added or removed.
Counter of barcodes scanned so far against the devices on the open box list (0 of 6 at this point).
Button on a device row, used to take a listed device off the box list when it is not in the box.
Exception: the device is on the list but was not in the box.
Exception: the device barcode was cut, folded or unreadable.
Status an order goes back to when its device is Missing.
Button pressed when the Quiqup rider is with you (usually around 3 PM). It closes the box.
Box status after Mark ready for collection is pressed.
Button on the box panel that prints the device barcodes. On the hand-over screen (t00184) it reads 'Print all barcodes (6)' while the device table below lists four rows.
Section where the single Quiqup label for the whole box appears after the box is marked ready. The screen gives the label name only; AWB is not expanded on screen or in the narration.
Column showing each device's scan result on the hand-over and tracker tables: Added, Scanned, or Pickup failed.
Scan status shown on each device row of the hand-over table (t00184). The screen does not say how the status is set.
Scan status meaning the device has been scanned and is all good.
Scan status that the trainer says means one of the two exceptions (Missing or Can't scan) happened.

terms.term: Tracker stages (Packing, Collected, Shipped, Flying, Delivering)
terms.meaning: Timeline shown after the hand-over. An order reaches Shipped when Quiqup scans it.

terms.term: With Quiqup / Scanned / With DHL / With TCG
terms.meaning: Tracker tabs that group boxes by where they are: with Quiqup, scanned, with DHL, with TCG.
Courier named in the tracker tab 'With TCG' and in the caption 'With The Courier Guy' (t00224).
Courier named in the tracker tab 'With DHL'.
The Quiqup driver who collects the box and scans its label.
The contact a seller messages with questions.

unclear.issue: The hand-over table on t00184.jpg (and t00187-t00196) shows four device rows (ZA-85669-1, ZA-85654-1, ZA-85719-1, ZA-85753-1) and the button 'Print all barcodes (6)'. The packing list on t00160.jpg had six devices, including ZA-85723-1 (iphone-17) and ZA-85666-1 (iphone-15-pro-max), which are not in the hand-over table. Neither the narration nor the screen explains this, so do not state how many devices a box holds at hand-over.

The Missing panel (t00233.jpg, t00237.jpg) uses ZA-85654-1 as its example device, but the hand-over table (t00184.jpg) shows ZA-85654-1 as Added and the scan status table (t00254.jpg, 04:10) shows it as Scanned. The narration does not say the Missing panel is illustrative, so do not present ZA-85654-1 as a real missing device.

The narration says 'Pickup failed means one of these two happened' but does not name the two causes on this slide. The earlier Missing and Can't scan panels suggest them, but that link is implied only.

privacy.what: Photos of the taped box with a printed Quiqup label (t00176 and t00180 right-hand photos, t00202 label photo over the panel, t00211 and t00214 box photos). The label carries printed address-style and tracking text that is too small to read reliably at this resolution. Check it for recipient or sender names and addresses before this material is shared with sellers.
